essence: The rite requires reciting a thousand syllables and performing oblation with lotus seeds.
After the preceding elements, one invokes the Godāvarī, Kālindī, and the oceans.
Mahāpadma, Śaṅkhapāla, and Kulika are to be placed on the eight petals.
Other applications declared by the divine mantra succeed in this context.
Through worship of this deity, death becomes submissive in Kāśī.
